messages:
ana: FYI i landed a tiny PR to the ruby quickstart sample that changes how binstubs are handled. CI is now failing on one matrix job.

kevin: what failure are you seeing?

ana: the job errors during `bundle exec rake db:migrate` with: `ruby: No such file or directory -- /workspace/bin/rails (LoadError)`. Looks like `bin/rails` is present but has a shebang pointing to an absolute path from my laptop's rbenv shim.

sam: ah the classic checked-in binstub issue. Did the PR remove bin/* or regenerate them?

ana: PR removes checked-in binstubs and uses `bundle config set --local path .bundle` + `bundle install --binstubs tmp/bin` in the setup script. I assumed CI would use the setup script but GH actions runs `bundle install` in a different step and doesn't execute `scripts/setup`.

kevin: so CI ends up with older binstubs from the repo. Can you paste the shebang line?

ana: sure: `#!/home/kevin/.rbenv/versions/3.1.2/bin/ruby` in bin/rails.

sam: that's the problem. On CI docker image ruby lives at `/usr/local/bin/ruby`. We have two fixes: 1) remove bin/* from the repo and ensure CI runs `scripts/setup` before other steps, or 2) add a CI step that runs `git checkout -- bin && bundle install` to regenerate. Option 1 is cleaner.

ci-bot: workflow run 34567 failed on job: test-linux-ruby3.1 :x:

olivia: quick thought: some third-party tools (spring, bootsnap) expect binstubs. If we stop checking them in, we should document the expected setup and provide a deterministic `scripts/setup --ci` path that CI calls to create ephemeral binstubs.

ana: added `scripts/setup --ci` which does `bundle config set --local bin tmp/bin && bundle install --jobs 4` and updates PATH in the action step. Pushed to PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/1999

kevin: can you also change the Dockerfile in `.github/workflows` to avoid caching old bin/entries? Sometimes checkout action preserves them. `actions/checkout` default preserves; you might want `fetch-depth: 0` or `clean: true`.

ana: changed checkout to `clean: true`. Also added a tiny rspec guard in CI that asserts `!git ls-files -- "bin/*"` so future commits don't accidentally re-add binstubs. snippet: `git ls-files -- "bin/*" | wc -l | grep -q "^0$"`.

sam: nice. Might be worth adding a note in CONTRIBUTING.md about binstub policy and adding a pre-commit hook sample that runs `git rm --cached bin/*` to help contributors.

olivia: unrelated but important: ensure auth/retry integration tests still find the mock server executable. If scripts/setup writes bin to tmp/bin, tests should look in that path. Update RSpec helper `MockServer.bin_path` to prefer `ENV['BUNDLE_BIN_PATH'] || File.join(Dir.pwd, 'tmp', 'bin')`.

kevin: good catch. I patched the test helper on a separate commit in the PR. ran unit + auth tests locally on a ruby 3.2 docker image and all green.

ci-bot: workflow run 34570 triggered for PR 1999 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

ana: thanks everyone. after this merges i'll open a follow-up to add a short section in the quickstart about "binstub pitfalls when copying sample apps" and a checklist for maintainers.

sam: approve once ci is green. also please add `DX:` prefix to the commit. our changelog script looks for that tag.

ana: done, CI passed and merged. :white_check_mark:

kevin: sweet. can we add a note to support FAQ so we can link to it next time?

olivia: i'll draft the FAQ blurb and post in #support.

ci-bot: workflow run 34570 succeeded :rocket:
